newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee ends higher, call rates volatile.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee ends higher, call rates volatile.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee erased early losses made on commercial and speculative dollar demand when banks sold dollars for rupees, dealers said.
The rupee closed 57.48 to the dollar, after opening at 57.55. The rupee ended Wednesday at 57.52.
"The rupee fell to 57.72 on import covering and speculation but recovered when a nubmer of banks sold dollars to generate rupees," said a Union Bank dealer.
Call money rates closed lower at 13 percent after rising to 16 percent from 15 percent at the open, dealers said.
"There was no shortage of money in the market. Call rates were volatile due to lenders holding back," said a Sampath Bank dealer.
